# Control Anchor / Triadic Brain

> Public offline Python reviewer demo and source-bound research on human-controlled AI, evidence provenance and cooperative compute.

The runnable demo uses synthetic inputs and scripted review, with no model calls
or networked compute. Broader network and cognitive capabilities remain proposed
or separately reported development. This is an optional reading index, not a
crawler standard, operational endpoint or grant of authority. Read the linked
source and its version before citing a claim. Contributions follow normal review.

## Start here

- [README and runnable scope](https://github.com/pdxvoiceteacher/control-anchor-reviewer-demo/blob/main/README.md): Start with the offline demo and capability boundaries.
- [Contribution opportunities](https://github.com/pdxvoiceteacher/control-anchor-reviewer-demo/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Human and authorized AI-assisted collaboration.
- [Agent working instructions](https://github.com/pdxvoiceteacher/control-anchor-reviewer-demo/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Evidence, privacy, review and validation requirements.
- [Limitations](https://github.com/pdxvoiceteacher/control-anchor-reviewer-demo/blob/main/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md): What the demo does not establish.
- [Recorded validation](https://github.com/pdxvoiceteacher/control-anchor-reviewer-demo/blob/main/VALIDATION.md): Dated observations; do not treat these as new runs.
- [Public subsystem directory](https://github.com/pdxvoiceteacher/control-anchor-reviewer-demo/blob/main/docs/PUBLIC_SUBSYSTEMS.md): Included UCC component and promotion boundary.
- [Retained-hypothesis comparison](https://github.com/pdxvoiceteacher/control-anchor-reviewer-demo/blob/main/docs/RETROSYNTHESIS_COMPONENT.md): Bounded Coherence and Sophia extraction.
- [Brain function directory](https://github.com/pdxvoiceteacher/control-anchor-reviewer-demo/blob/main/docs/brain-map/README.md): Code, development and proposed design separated.
- [Triadic Brain technical manuscript](https://github.com/pdxvoiceteacher/control-anchor-reviewer-demo/blob/main/docs/papers/triadic-brain-micro-spectrum/README.md): Edition 1.2, companion and source-bound language editions.
- [Network academic supplement](https://github.com/pdxvoiceteacher/control-anchor-reviewer-demo/blob/main/docs/papers/triadic-brain-micro-spectrum/2026-11-04-network-supplement/README.md): Representation, protocol and execution boundaries; proposed evaluation.
- [Design whitepaper](https://github.com/pdxvoiceteacher/control-anchor-reviewer-demo/blob/main/docs/whitepaper/triadic-brain-20261102/README.md): English R6, visual atlas and language edition indexes.
- [License scope](https://github.com/pdxvoiceteacher/control-anchor-reviewer-demo/blob/main/LICENSE_SCOPE.md): Path-specific rights; public access is not a blanket license.
- [Project metadata](https://github.com/pdxvoiceteacher/control-anchor-reviewer-demo/blob/main/codemeta.json): Machine-readable software description.
- [Discovery limits](https://github.com/pdxvoiceteacher/control-anchor-reviewer-demo/blob/main/docs/DISCOVERY.md): Search, crawler and indexing boundaries.
